Interrupted data phases resume from durable checkpoints.
Concurrent identical and conflicting requests exercise idempotency and optimistic concurrency.
Cross-tenant reads and writes exercise row policies and privileged-role posture.
Direct event and evidence mutation exercises database privilege boundaries.
Equivalent instants decimals unit mappings JSON edge cases and status invariants exercise primitive contracts.
Representative query plans exercise indexes retention and partition decisions.
Backup restore rollback and data exit reconstruct the accepted evidence boundary.
